title: Referrals and Authorizations Extension Block After a Psychiatric Readmission
content:
When an approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** is extended, a readmission sets a longer block for the extension.

## Records read

- From the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines: whether an inpatient mental health admission line of the patient is dated in the last month.
- From the authorization's unit history: whether it already holds an extension entry.

## Rule

| Inpatient mental health admission line in the last month | Earlier extension on the authorization | Block |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 5 days |
| yes | one or more | 4 days |
| no | any | the type's extension units |

In words: where an inpatient mental health admission line of the patient is dated in the last month and the authorization has no earlier extension, the block is five days; where such a line is dated in the last month and an earlier extension exists, the block is four days; otherwise the block is the type's extension units.
